_notes: OUT-OF-SAMPLE HOLDOUT validation for the Footprint Reversal AutoTrader scaffold.
Run this ONCE, last. SIM ONLY. This is an UNTESTED, UNPROVEN scaffold — treat a
passing holdout as 'not obviously broken', never as 'has edge'.
PURPOSE: after searching the small grid in StrategyOptimizerConfig.json (imbalance %,
PB ticks, R:R), you LOCK one final configuration in the study and run it ONCE over the
untouched holdout window. It is the validation step, not another search. Re-sweeping on
the holdout = peeking, which destroys the point. ONE look at the ONE final config.
TRAIN / HOLDOUT SPLIT (adjust dates to your available intraday TICK data):
SEARCH (train): run StrategyOptimizerConfig.json with the CHART data range END set to
HOLDOUT (test): this file, startDate = 2026-06-15, with the CHART extended THROUGH
today. The optimizer has NO end-date field (reads ONLY startDate and
replays to the LAST LOADED CHART BAR), so the window end is a CHART
setting, not a config field.
FOOTPRINT CAVEAT: volume-at-price data must exist across the WHOLE window, so intraday
tick data must be loaded for both train and holdout, plus the NumberBars2 dependency.
If you get zero trades, that (or a missing dependency) is why — not necessarily 'no edge'.
SET MANUALLY before running (optimizer leaves increment-0 inputs alone):
- Search winners: Buy/Sell Imbalance % (6), PB ticks (9), Reward:Risk (14), Stop Buffer (13)
- Input NumberBars2 (3) = study ID, Relative Volume SG14 (4) = SG14
- Enable Order Submission (10)=Yes, ALLOW LIVE (11)=No, FLATTEN NOW (18)=No,
Order Quantity (12)=1, Trade >> Trade Simulation Mode = ON
THE SWEEP BELOW IS A 1-COMBO RUN: it re-asserts your locked imbalance % so the optimizer
executes EXACTLY ONE replay. Set BOTH min AND max to your search-winner value (shown here
as 400 — REPLACE with yours). increment 1 with min==max => 1 combination.
VERDICT RULE (decide BEFORE you look): if holdout P/L flips sign, or Sharpe / Profit
Factor collapses vs the search window, DISCARD the config — it was overfit. Passing does
NOT certify an edge; the holdout is a couple of weeks of a scaffold with no prior testing.
Certification needs YEARS of OOS. Keep this SIM-only; do not trade it.

paramConfigs._name: Buy/Sell Imbalance % Threshold (LOCK to search winner: set BOTH min and max to it)
